title: Experience Art: Painting Classes in Denver
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Come experience one of Denver’s most unique attractions. Founded in 2014, Puff, Pass & Paint has been featured in dozens of national and international press. Find out what the buzz is all about!

Create a unique piece of art to take home with you! Often duplicated, come see the original where it all began! Classes offered daily throughout the evening and take 2 hours to complete. Snacks, water, and painting supplies provided.
